segments.name: Therapeutics
segments.description: Discovers, develops and seeks to commercialize blood-brain barrier-crossing biotherapeutics for patients with neurodegenerative, lysosomal storage and other serious diseases.
segments.evidence: The Company has one operating segment with the goal to discover, develop and commercialize therapeutics ("Therapeutics").

revenueModel.text: The company has no product sales revenue; all revenue to date has been collaboration and license revenue from its collaboration agreements with partners such as Biogen, Takeda and Sanofi.
revenueModel.evidence: All revenue to date has been collaboration and license revenue from the Company's collaboration agreements.

changes.text: In 2024, the company divested its small molecule programs to Tenvie, receiving consideration and retaining rights to future royalties on net sales of certain products.
changes.evidence: The Company recognized a gain on divestiture of approximately $ 14.5 million in the Consolidated Statements of Operations and Comprehensive Loss during the year ended December 31, 2024 , representing the difference between the fair value of the consideration received and the carrying amount of the Divested Assets.
